name: Sigil of Strom
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
In ancient times, trolls fought against the Arathorian Empire and our most capable adversary, Lord Ignaeus of Strom, named Trollbane. He rode into battle wielding Trol'kalar--troll slayer, in their ancient tongue.

But now the sons of Trollbane are weakened, their stronghold brought to ruin.

The sword is protected by several sigils that were divided among the survivors of Stromgarde, and we must retrieve them.

The first was taken by the Syndicate, one of their men in Stromgarde should have it.
narrative.objectives: Get the Sigil of Strom for Zengu in Hammerfall.
narrative.offerRewardText: Excellent, mon. That's a good start to collecting the sigils we'll need to remove Trol'kalar from Trollbane's tomb.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you located the first sigil yet? It is most likely carried on the person of one of the Syndicate agents in Stromgarde.

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 37 to 42, 18,920 XP in all.

quests.name: Trollbane
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands and speak with Zengu.

quests.name: Sigil of Strom
quests.objectiveText: Get the Sigil of Strom for Zengu in Hammerfall.

quests.name: The Broken Sigil
quests.objectiveText: Retrieve the 5 Sigil Fragments from the defenders in Stromgarde, and bring them to Tor'gan in Hammerfall.

quests.name: Sigil of Thoradin
quests.objectiveText: Bring the restored Sigil of Thoradin to Zengu in Hammerfall.

quests.name: Sigil of Arathor
quests.objectiveText: Retrieve the Sigil of Arathor and return it to Zengu in Hammerfall.

quests.name: Sigil of Trollbane
quests.objectiveText: Kill Prince Galen Trollbane and bring the Sigil of Trollbane to Zengu in Hammerfall.

quests.name: Trol'kalar
quests.objectiveText: Retrieve Trol'kalar from Trollbane's tomb in Stromgarde.

quests.name: Trol'kalar
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Trol'kalar to Zengu in Hammerfall.
